name: go-code-review
description: > Comprehensive code review checklist for Go projects. Evaluates code quality, idiomatic patterns, error handling, naming, package structure, and test coverage. Use when reviewing Go code, PRs, or before merging changes. Trigger examples: "review this code", "check this PR", "code review", "review Go file". Not for: security audits (go-security-audit), performance analysis (go-performance-review).
author: eduardo-sl
summary_zh: 面向 Go 项目代码审查的全面检查清单，帮助评估代码质量、惯用写法、错误处理、命名、包结构和测试覆盖率，适合审核代码、PR 或合并前检查。
